chapter: Jazz, Chano Pozo and Dizzy Gillespie
title: Was Chano Pozo playing in clave with Dizzy?
summary: Dizzy told him that Chano knew what to do once he sang him the melody, and clave guided him.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: I remember having read a comment that you made that when Chano Pozo played jazz with Dizzy Gillespie, you say that the music was not in clave. Is this true?

Well, not exactly not in clave. What was true was that for Chano the arrangement was a bit difficult. So Dizzy told me that once he sang the melody to Chano, Chano already knew what he had to do. Because obviously the custom of Latinos, mainly the rhythm with clave, are guided by the clave because the clave to the rhythm is like a metronome. But then that was where Dizzy told me, "No - after I sang the melody to him, he knew what he had to do." So then, Chano Pozo already was familiar with everything that was happening there and so he knew where the clave was.
